chunks.rationale: electron/test/source-control.test.js is the probe contract: missing CLI, JSON auth (gh >= 2.81), text auth on older gh, upgrade-not-auth-failed when old gh cannot report sign-in, Bitbucket env token, cache until Rescan, and isGhAuthFailure busting that cache. test/sourceControl.test.ts is the T3-shaped readiness helper #459 will consume. Settings and next-git button tests prove the UI copy and the disable path.
risks: Probe tests inject bins and must not clobber PATH — #!/usr/bin/env node needs node on PATH. A future test that sets PATH: tmpdir will look like 'gh is installed but auth unknown'.
gh spawn tests stay POSIX-oriented (execFile + shebang), same as the rest of the gh suite. Win32 az.cmd is still execFile, not cross-spawn.
Renderer tests inject onDiscover / window.coder; they never run the real probe.

chunks.rationale: electron/sourceControl.js is the new probe. One sourceControl:discover IPC, in-memory cache, explicit rescan. GitHub uses gh --version then gh auth status --json hosts when >= 2.81, else text. Outdated is ONLY when we cannot parse auth AND the binary is below 2.81 — a working older gh stays available so Create PR does not lie. GitLab/Azure are CLI probes; Bitbucket is env tokens (SOLENTA_BITBUCKET_*), ready for #456. Timeouts are 8s and never Sync.
risks: az account show can be slow on a cold Azure CLI; we treat timeout as unknown, not missing, so we do not tell a signed-in user to brew install azure-cli.
gh auth status --json always exits 0; readiness is state===success on the active account. Empty hosts => unauthenticated.
CODER_GH_BIN / CODER_GLAB_BIN / CODER_AZ_BIN override bins for tests. Production uses PATH names gh/glab/az.
isGhAuthFailure in worktrees.js lazy-requires sourceControl.invalidateDiscoveryCache. A circular load would silently skip invalidation (try/catch); sourceControl.js must not import worktrees.js.

chunks.rationale: Settings → Source Control lists each forge with signed-in-as / what's missing / a copy-pasteable fix and Rescan. nextGitAction gates create-pr, checks, and merge (not Push or Commit) when github.ready is false; null still means 'probe not loaded, keep the old click-and-fail path'. src/sourceControl.ts exports buildAddProjectRemoteSourceReadiness / sortAddProjectProviderSources for #459 — Add Project itself is unchanged.
risks: Header button state can lag a Settings Rescan until the next git refresh (thread update, changes, or a failed gh action). Cache is already fresh; only React state is stale.
Add-project clone source list is NOT wired. The helper is there so #459 does not grow a second probe.
Planboard still reports auth after a failed gh call. Same regex now also busts the Settings cache.
Copy uses navigator.clipboard; jsdom has none so the button is inert in tests, same as Markdown.

Not verified in a live Electron window this turn — electron + renderer tests only. Open Settings → Source Control on the running app is the real check (gh is signed in as currentbits on this machine).

Windows az.cmd / glab.cmd still go through execFile, which cannot run .cmd (EINVAL). Same standing limitation as gh. Discovery will report those as missing on win32 until those call sites switch to cross-spawn.
Bitbucket env names are SOLENTA_BITBUCKET_* — nothing else reads them yet (#456).
Did not implement clone-from-GitHub / publish (#459). Readiness data is the feed; the source list UI is a separate issue.
